description: Build a free-form draft by default, or optionally use an on-site template. No request is restricted to the example templates. No publishing, hiring or payment. No model is called. Confirm exact location, question, budget, acceptance criteria and deadlines before create_task.

amount.description: Non-negative integer minor units of currency, within the JSON/JavaScript safe integer range. No business amount limit. Zero is a free task.

currency.description: Task budget denomination. Amount is integer cents of this currency; omitted currency means HKD. No currency conversion occurs.
